Description Integral transmission

Reference I 11.1

1 Symbol

1 Dimension

Definition

or explanation

Combination of one or more hydraulic pumps and one or more motors forming a unit. During use, the functions of the pump and motor are determined by their actual function at a specified time. The input shaft is connected to the source of energy; the output shaft is connected to the load and is driven by the motor(s)

of terms without
Description

symbols
I
Definition or explanation -The swept volume setting is determined by a dependent parameter such as flow, pressure and power --The control setting varies so as to maintain the pressure constant within limits -The control setting varies so as to follow a predetermined power characteristic -The control setting varies so as to follow a predetermined flow characteristic Regulated adjustment to give a given characteristic power curve _______-__ ___-___ Regulated adjustment to give a characteristic torque curve ____~---Regulated adjustment to give a characteristic speed curve ---__-__---The swept volume setting is determined by an independent parameter

Open loop control Closed loop control Constant pressure control Power control Output flow control Power regulator Torque regulator Speed regulation

----

The term "open loop control" is used here where the input parameters (c, n, . . .I act upon the output parameter or parameters ( V, q ", p . . .I according to a relationship applicable to the system and without being affected by these output parameters. All the elements which so operate are termed the control loop and the last link is the output control member. The term "closed loop control" or "regulating control" is used where the output parameters are within the control loop and are compared with one or more selected quantities to which they must be made equal by the control mechanism. This equalisation is effected by the "output member" at the end of the control loop. In the present case, the output control member is that part of the pump which changes the swept volume. The output parameters are the flow and the output pressure. ~-_---------_-_-- -----_..-------Circuit Path of hydraulic fluid in the transmission ---__Circuit in which return fluid is directed to the reservoir before re-circulation ~~~~~~~ without 1".:~~~~~~~111~
